Bringing the Club Back

Muhlenberg’s Fencing Club existed before my involvement, but it went inactive after its President graduated at the end of the 2022-2023 academic year.

In the second semester of 2023-2024, a friend of mine and I helped revive and re-establish the club. We brought practices back after a semester without the club.

Learning, Practicing & Bouting

Coach Paul McAndrew and former club President Noah Katz (’23) returned to teach. Club equipment was provided, and instruction began with the basics, so students could join without buying gear or having fenced before.

It was a relaxed way to learn fencing and practice with other students. I helped organize the club and served as its President.

Watch a Practice Bout

A short recorded bout features me fencing Benjamin Dicker, with Paul McAndrew refereeing and Noah Katz filming.
